lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਰੀ ਫੇਰੀ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਈ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਨੂਪੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਠਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vaaree pheree sadaa ghumaaee kavan anoop tero thaau ||1||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice, forever devoted to You. Your place is incomparably beautiful! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਾਲਹਿ ਸਗਲਿਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਛਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarab pratipaalahi sagal samaalahi sagaliaa teree chhaau ||
lines.translation: You cherish and nurture all; You take care of all, and Your shade covers all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਦਿਖਾਉ ॥੨॥੨॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ke prabh purakh bidhaate ghat ghat tujhahi dikhaau ||2||2||4||
lines.translation: You are the Primal Creator, the God of Nanak; I behold You in each and every heart. ||2||2||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pri kee preet piaaree ||
lines.translation: I love the Love of my Beloved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਗਨ ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਚਿਤਵਉ ਆਸਾ ਨੈਨਹੁ ਤਾਰ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: magan manai mahi chitavau aasaa nainahu taar tuhaaree || rahaau ||
lines.translation: My mind is intoxicated with delight, and my consciousness is filled with hope; my eyes are drenched with Your Love. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਦਿਨ ਪਹਰ ਮੂਰਤ ਪਲ ਕੈਸੇ ਓਇ ਪਲ ਘਰੀ ਕਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi din pahar moorat pal kaise oi pal gharee kihaaree ||
lines.translation: Blessed is that day, that hour, minute and second when the heavy, rigid shutters are opened, and desire is quenched.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੂਲੇ ਕਪਟ ਧਪਟ ਬੁਝਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜੀਵਉ ਪੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: khoole kapat dhapat bujh trisanaa jeevau pekh darasaaree ||1||
lines.translation: Seeing the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, I live. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਨੁ ਸੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਿਨੇਹਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਉਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun s jatan upaau kinehaa sevaa kaun beechaaree ||
lines.translation: What is the method, what is the effort, and what is the service, which inspires me to contemplate You?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਤਜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: maan abhimaan mohu taj naanak sa(n)tah sa(n)g udhaaree ||2||3||5||
lines.translation: Abandon your egotistical pride and attachment; O Nanak, you shall be saved in the Society of the Saints. ||2||3||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har gun gaavahu ||
lines.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਹੁ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਗੋਬਿਦੇ ਅਪਨਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: karahu kripaa gopaal gobide apanaa naam japaavahu || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Have Mercy on me, O Life of the World, O Lord of the Universe, that I may chant Your Name. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਤੇ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaadh leee prabh aan bikhai te saadhasa(n)g man laavahu ||
lines.translation: Please lift me up, God, out of vice and corruption, and attach my mind to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕਟਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਅਪਨਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਦਿਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhram bhau mohu katio gur bachanee apanaa daras dikhaavahu ||1||
lines.translation: Doubt, fear and attachment are eradicated from that person who follows the Guru's Teachings, and gazes on the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ ਹੋਇ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਤਜਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kee ren hoi man meraa aha(n)budh tajaavahu ||
lines.translation: Let my mind become the dust of all; may I abandon my egotistical intellect.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੪॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: apanee bhagat dehi daiaalaa vadabhaagee naanak har paavahu ||2||4||6||
lines.translation: Please bless me with Your devotional worship, O Merciful Lord; by great good fortune, O Nanak, I have found the Lord. ||2||4||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥ ਜਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin janam akaarath jaat ||
lines.translation: Without the Lord, life is useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਆਨ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਚਤ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਪਹਿਰਤ ਖਾਤ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj gopaal aan ra(n)g raachat mithiaa pahirat khaat || rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who forsake the Lord, and become engrossed in other pleasures - false and useless are the clothes they wear, and the food they eat. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਸੁਖ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਮਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan joban sa(n)pai sukh bhougavai sa(n)g na nibahat maat ||
lines.translation: The pleasures of wealth, youth, property and comforts will not stay with you, O mother.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਾਵਰ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਛਾਇਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mrig trisanaa dekh rachio baavar drum chhaaiaa ra(n)g raat ||1||
lines.translation: Seeing the mirage, the madman is entangled in it; he is imbued with pleasures that pass away, like the shade of a tree. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਮੋਹ ਮਹਾ ਮਦ ਮੋਹਤ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕੈ ਖਾਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: maan moh mahaa mad mohat kaam krodh kai khaat ||
lines.translation: Totally intoxicated with the wine of pride and attachment, he has fallen into the pit of sexual desire and anger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਹੋਇ ਸਹਾਤ ॥੨॥੫॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi lehu daas naanak kau prabh jeeu hoi sahaat ||2||5||7||
lines.translation: O Dear God, please be the Help and Support of servant Nanak; please take me by the hand, and uplift me. ||2||5||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਚਾਲਸਿ ਸਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin koi na chaalas saath ||
lines.translation: Nothing goes along with the mortal, except for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਕਰੁਣਾਪਤਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਨਾਥਾ ਕੇ ਨਾਥ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: deenaa naath karunaapat suaamee anaathaa ke naath || rahaau ||
lines.translation: He is the Master of the meek, the Lord of Mercy, my Lord and Master, the Master of the masterless. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਤ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਰਸ ਭੋੁਗਵਤ ਨਹ ਨਿਬਹਤ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਪਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: sut sa(n)pat bikhiaa ras bhougavat nah nibahat jam kai paath ||
lines.translation: Children, possessions and the enjoyment of corrupt pleasures do not go along with the mortal on the path of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਗਾਉ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਉਧਰੁ ਸਾਗਰ ਕੇ ਖਾਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan gaau gun gobi(n)d udhar saagar ke khaat ||1||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the treasure of the Naam, and the Lord of the Universe, the mortal is carried across the deep ocean. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਨਿ ਸਮਰਥ ਅਕਥ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਲਾਥ ॥
lines.transliteration: saran samarath akath agochar har simarat dukh laath ||
lines.translation: In the Sanctuary of the All-powerful, Indescribable, Unfathomable Lord, meditate in remembrance on Him, and your pains shall vanish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੀਨ ਧੂਰਿ ਜਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਮਿਲੈ ਲਿਖਤ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਾਥ ॥੨॥੬॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak deen dhoor jan baa(n)chhat milai likhat dhur maath ||2||6||8||
lines.translation: Nanak longs for the dust of the feet of the Lord's humble servant; he shall obtain it only if such pre-ordained destiny is written on his forehead. ||2||6||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਦਾਰਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kedaaraa mahalaa 5 ghar 5 ||
lines.translation: Kaydaaraa, Fifth Mehl, Fifth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਸਰਤ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bisarat naahi man te haree ||
lines.translation: I do not forget the Lord in my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਇਹ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਹਾ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਭਈ ਆਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab ih preet mahaa prabal bhaee aan bikhai jaree || rahaau ||
lines.translation: This love has now become very strong; it has burnt away other corruption. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੂੰਦ ਕਹਾ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਰਹਤ ਨ ਘਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: boo(n)d kahaa tiaag chaatrik meen rahat na gharee ||
lines.translation: How can the rainbird forsake the rain-drop? The fish cannot survive without water, even for an instant.
